blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — The Palace spokesperson on Thursday dismissed Vice President Sara Duterte’s assertion that sovereignty was at the core of her siblings’ legal bid to challenge their father’s arrest and surrender to the International Criminal Court (ICC) at The Hague in 2025. Former President Rodrigo Duterte, who will stand trial on Nov. 30 for crimes against humanity due to his bloody war on drugs, was brought to the ICC on the strength of a law that authorizes the government to turn over individuals accused of international offenses like crimes against humanity, Palace spokesperson Claire Castro said at her regular […]...
